text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلطُّورِ

translations.asad: CONSIDER Mount Sinai!
translations.sahih: By the mount

text.arabic: وَكِتَٰبٍۢ مَّسْطُورٍۢ

translations.asad: Consider [God’s] revelation, inscribed
translations.sahih: And [by] a Book inscribed

text.arabic: فِى رَقٍّۢ مَّنشُورٍۢ

translations.asad: on wide-open scrolls.
translations.sahih: In parchment spread open

text.arabic: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ

translations.asad: Consider the long-enduring house [of worship]!
translations.sahih: And [by] the frequented House

text.arabic: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ

translations.asad: Consider the vault [of heaven] raised high!
translations.sahih: And [by] the heaven raised high

text.arabic: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ

translations.asad: Consider the surf-swollen sea!
translations.sahih: And [by] the sea filled [with fire],

text.arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ

translations.asad: VERILY, [O man,] the suffering decreed by thy Sustainer [for the sinners] will indeed come to pass:
translations.sahih: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.

text.arabic: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍۢ

translations.asad: there is none who could avert it.
translations.sahih: Of it there is no preventer.

text.arabic: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًۭا

translations.asad: [It will come to pass] on the Day when the skies will be convulsed in [a great] convulsion,
translations.sahih: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion

text.arabic: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًۭا

translations.asad: and the mountains will move with [an awesome] movement.
translations.sahih: And the mountains will pass on, departing -

text.arabic: فَوَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

translations.asad: Woe, then, on that Day to all who give the lie to the truth –
translations.sahih: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,

text.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍۢ يَلْعَبُونَ

translations.asad: all those who [throughout their lives] but idly played with things vain –
translations.sahih: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.

text.arabic: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا

translations.asad: on the Day when they shall be thrust into the fire with [an irresistible] thrust, [and will be told:]
translations.sahih: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],

text.arabic: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

translations.asad: “This is the fire which you were wont to call a lie!
translations.sahih: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.

text.arabic: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ

translations.asad: Was it, then, a delusion or is it that you failed to see [its truth]?
translations.sahih: Then is this magic, or do you not see?

text.arabic: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.asad: Endure it [now]! But [whether you] bear yourselves with patience or without patience, it will be the same to you: you are but being requited for what you were wont to do.”
translations.sahih: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."

text.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَعِيمٍۢ

translations.asad: [But,] verily, the God-conscious will find themselves [on that Day] in gardens and in bliss,
translations.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,

text.arabic: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

translations.asad: rejoicing in all that their Sustainer will have granted them: for their Sustainer will have warded off from them all suffering through the blazing fire.
translations.sahih: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.

text.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.asad: [And they will be told:] “Eat and drink with good cheer as an outcome of what you were wont to do,
translations.sahih: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

text.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّصْفُوفَةٍۢ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ

translations.asad: reclining on couches [of happiness] ranged in rows!” And [in that paradise] We shall mate them with companions pure, most beautiful of eye.
translations.sahih: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

text.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌۭ

translations.asad: And as for those who have attained to faith and whose offspring will have followed them in faith, We shall unite them with their offspring; and We shall not let aught of their deeds go to waste: [but] every human being will be held in pledge for whatever he has earned.
translations.sahih: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.

text.arabic: وَأَمْدَدْنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ وَلَحْمٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

translations.asad: And We shall bestow on them fruit and meat in abundance - whatever they may desire:
translations.sahih: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.

text.arabic: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا لَّا لَغْوٌۭ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌۭ

translations.asad: and in that [paradise] they shall pass on to one another a cup which will not give rise to empty talk, and neither incite to sin.
translations.sahih: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.

text.arabic: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌۭ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ

translations.asad: And they will be waited upon by [immortal] youths, [as if they were children] of their own, [as pure] as if they were pearls hidden in their shells.
translations.sahih: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.

text.arabic: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

translations.asad: And they [who are thus blest] will turn to one another, asking each other [about their past lives].
translations.sahih: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

text.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ

translations.asad: They will say: “Behold, aforetime - when we were [still living] in the midst of our kith and kin - we were full of fear [at the thought of God’s dis­pleasure]:
translations.sahih: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah].

text.arabic: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ

translations.asad: and so God has graced us with His favour, and has warded off from us all suffering through the scorching winds [of frustration].
translations.sahih: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.

text.arabic: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

translations.asad: Verily, we did invoke Him [alone] ere this: [and now He has shown us] that He alone is truly benign, a true dispenser of grace!”
translations.sahih: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."

text.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍۢ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ

translations.asad: EXHORT, then, [O Prophet, all men:] for, by thy Sustainer’s grace, thou art neither a soothsayer nor a madman.
translations.sahih: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.

text.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌۭ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ

translations.asad: Or do they say, “[He is but] a poet - let us wait what time will do unto him”?
translations.sahih: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time?"

text.arabic: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ

translations.asad: Say thou: “Wait, [then,] hopefully; behold, I, too, shall hopefully wait with you!”
translations.sahih: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."

text.arabic: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ

translations.asad: Is it their minds that bid them [to take] this [attitude] - or are they [simply] people filled with overweening arrogance?
translations.sahih: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?

text.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.asad: Or do they say, “He himself has composed this [message]”? Nay, but they are not willing to believe!
translations.sahih: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.

text.arabic: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ

translations.asad: But then, [if they deem it the work of a mere mortal,] let them produce another discourse like it - if what they say be true!
translations.sahih: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.

text.arabic: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ

translations.asad: [Or do they deny the existence of God?] Have they themselves been created without anything [that might have caused their creation]? or were they, perchance, their own creators?
translations.sahih: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?

text.arabic: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ

translations.asad: [And] have they created the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they have no certainty of anything!
translations.sahih: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.

text.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ

translations.asad: [How could they?] Are thy Sustainer’s treasures with them? Or are they in charge [of destiny]?
translations.sahih: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?

text.arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌۭ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ

translations.asad: Or have they a ladder by which they could [ascend to ultimate truths and] listen [to what is beyond the reach of human perception]? Let, then, any of them who have listened [to it] produce a manifest proof [of his knowledge]!
translations.sahih: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority.

text.arabic: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ

translations.asad: Or, [if you believe in God, how can you believe that] He has [chosen to have] daughters, whereas you yourselves would have [only] sons?
translations.sahih: Or has He daughters while you have sons?

text.arabic: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ

translations.asad: Or is it that [they who reject thy message, O Muhammad, fear lest] thou ask of them a reward, so that they would be burdened with debt [if they should listen to thee]?
translations.sahih: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

text.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

translations.asad: Or [do they think] that the hidden reality [of all that exists] is almost within their grasp, so that [in time] they can write it down?
translations.sahih: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

text.arabic: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ

translations.asad: Or do they want to entrap [thee in contradic­tions]? But they who are bent on denying the truth - it is they who are truly entrapped!
translations.sahih: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.

text.arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

translations.asad: Have they, then, any deity other than God? Utterly remote is God, in His limitless glory, from anything to which men may ascribe a share in His divinity!
translations.sahih: Or have they a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.

text.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًۭا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌۭ مَّرْكُومٌۭ

translations.asad: AND YET, if they [who refuse to see the truth] were to see part of the sky falling down, they would [only] say, “[It is but] a mass of clouds!”
translations.sahih: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."

text.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ

translations.asad: Hence, leave them alone until they face that [Judgment] Day of theirs, when they will be stricken with terror:
translations.sahih: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -

text.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

translations.asad: the Day when none of their scheming will be of the least avail to them, and they will receive no succour.
translations.sahih: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.

text.arabic: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.asad: But, verily, for those who are bent on doing evil, there is suffering in store [even] closer at hand than that [supreme suffering in the hereafter]: but most of them are not aware of it.
translations.sahih: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.

text.arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ

translations.asad: And so, await in patience thy Sustainer’s judgment, for thou art well within Our sight. And extol thy Sustainer’s limitless glory and praise whenever thou risest up,
translations.sahih: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.

text.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ

translations.asad: and extol His glory at night, and at the time when the stars retreat.
translations.sahih: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
